gist.summary: Added an always-present `paid_only` boolean beside `pricing` on every `/v1/models` list entry and `/v1/models/{model}` response, matching the existing `/models` field. OpenAI-compatible clients can now identify models that require paid Pollen rather than Quest Pollen without a second API call. The flag is top-level because it describes payment eligibility, not a unit price; no other public API behavior changes.
